_help: Quiz for The Vault Dive (Famous Web3 Hacks). 5 to 8 questions. answer must match one of the options exactly. explain is shown after the quiz. This folder is never shown to visitors.

questions.question: What does "not your keys, not your coins" mean?
options: If someone else holds the keys, they control your crypto
Keys are only for bitcoin
Lost keys can be reset by email
Exchanges never lose coins
questions.answer: If someone else holds the keys, they control your crypto
questions.explain: Mt. Gox, Coincheck, FTX and others lost money customers had left with them.

questions.question: Why are bridges a big target?
options: They hold huge pools of money in one place
They are run by banks
They only hold small amounts
They cannot be updated
questions.answer: They hold huge pools of money in one place
questions.explain: Ronin, Wormhole, Nomad, Poly Network and the BNB bridge were all bridges.

questions.question: Where should most of your crypto live?
options: In a wallet only you control, mostly offline
On whichever exchange pays the most
Split across as many new apps as possible
In a screenshot of your seed phrase
questions.answer: In a wallet only you control, mostly offline
questions.explain: Keep on exchanges only what you are actively trading.

questions.question: A recruiter sends a surprise job offer with a file to open. What is the safe move?
options: Do not open it on a computer that touches your crypto
Open it right away
Forward it to your whole team
Send your wallet address to apply
questions.answer: Do not open it on a computer that touches your crypto
questions.explain: Fake job offers helped attackers into Ronin and other hacks.

questions.question: What does an audit mean for an app?
options: It lowers the risk, but bugs can still be there
The app can never be hacked
Your money is insured
The team will refund any loss
questions.answer: It lowers the risk, but bugs can still be there
questions.explain: Euler had been audited and still lost about $197 million.

questions.question: In the Bybit hack, what went wrong when the signers approved the transfer?
options: The screen showed something different from what they really signed
They shared their password on social media
The exchange had no security at all
A customer guessed the password
questions.answer: The screen showed something different from what they really signed
questions.explain: Check what you are really signing. Hardware wallets show the true details.
